findings.evidence: Lines 301–306 define only `H`, `[AddCommGroup H]`, and `basis : Basis (Fin 2) ℤ H`; repository grep finds no `BoundaryTorus` definition, while roadmap lines 538–545 explicitly require a primitive class in `H₁(T; ℤ)` and a meridian/Seifert-longitude framing.
